name: matterbridge-homey
description: Matterbridge plugin that exposes Athom Homey Pro devices to Matter
author: Stefan Schweiger

scripts.cleanBuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.cleanBuildProduction: npm run clean && npm run buildProduction
scripts.git:status: git status && git branch -vv && git stash list && git fsck --full --no-reflogs --no-dangling && git worktree list
scripts.git:remote: git remote -v && git remote show origin
scripts.git:hardreset:main: git fetch origin && git checkout main && git reset --hard origin/main
scripts.git:hardreset:dev: git fetch origin && git checkout dev && git reset --hard origin/dev
scripts.git:hardreset:edge: git fetch origin && git checkout edge && git reset --hard origin/edge
scripts.git:merge:dev: git fetch origin && git checkout -b dev-backup-001 && git checkout dev && git merge origin/main && git push origin dev
scripts.git:rebase:dev: git fetch origin && git checkout -b dev-backup-001 && git checkout dev && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease origin dev
scripts.reset: npm run deepClean && npm run softReset
scripts.softReset: npm install --no-fund --no-audit && npm prune --no-fund --no-audit && npm link --no-fund --no-audit matterbridge && npm run build && npm run typecheck
scripts.softReset:bun: bun install && bun prune && bun link matterbridge && bun run build && bun run typecheck
scripts.checkDependencies: npm install --no-fund --no-audit --no-save npm-check-updates && ncu && npm run softReset
scripts.updateDependencies: npm install --no-fund --no-audit --no-save npm-check-updates && ncu -u && npm run softReset
scripts.runMeBeforePublish: npm run cleanBuild && npm run format && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run cleanBuildProduction && npm pkg delete devDependencies scripts automator && node scripts/prepublish-clean.mjs && npm install --no-fund --no-audit --omit=dev && npm shrinkwrap --omit=dev
scripts.npmPack: npx shx cp package.json package.json.backup && node scripts/version.mjs dev && npm run prepublishOnly && npm pack && npx shx cp package.json.backup package.json && npx shx rm -f package.json.backup && npm run reset
scripts.npmPublishTagDev: npx shx cp package.json package.json.backup && node scripts/version.mjs dev && npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish --tag dev && npx shx cp package.json.backup package.json && npx shx rm -f package.json.backup && npm run reset
scripts.npmPublishTagEdge: npx shx cp package.json package.json.backup && node scripts/version.mjs edge && npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish --tag edge && npx shx cp package.json.backup package.json && npx shx rm -f package.json.backup && npm run reset
scripts.npmPublishTagLatest: npx shx cp package.json package.json.backup && npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish --tag latest && npx shx cp package.json.backup package.json && npx shx rm -f package.json.backup && npm run reset
